notes: Orientation: the input mesh axes are assumed to already match the requested x/y/z dimension axes; no rotation or axis permutation was applied. The GLB was read in its native glTF frame (+Y up) without conversion.
Bounding box centred at the origin; source centre was (-0.000949889, -0.00101653, -0.000946134) in input units.
Scaled per axis independently from source extents (1.89981, 1.01474, 1.8998) (input units, treated as unknown) to confirmed full extents (0.043, 0.027, 0.058) m.
Nonuniform distortion: per-axis scale factors differ by up to 34.9% (x:y:z ratio 1.000:1.176:1.349); the mesh's proportions did not match the confirmed dimensions.
Collision is a box centred at the origin with the confirmed dimensions; mass and friction were passed through unchanged and not inferred from geometry.
Simulation visual is a geometry-only copy; original reconstruction and prepared materials are retained separately. No texture fidelity is claimed.
